health-feature.quote: Long lasting chewing fun helps tartar and plaque control

texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Flavours Triple Flavour Twisted Sticks combine three flavours: chewy pork hide and beef hide wrapped in succulent chicken breast. These long-lasting twisted sticks help control tartar and plaque build-up through their natural abrasive action while chewing. Rich in protein, low in fat, oven baked, with no added sugar, flavour enhancers, GMOs, gluten or artificial preservatives. Ideal for dogs of all sizes. Pack of 10 sticks, 70 g.
texts.feeding_instructions: Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily calorie intake. XS dogs (1–5 kg): one treat over two days. S dogs (5–10 kg): one treat per day. M dogs (10–25 kg): up to two treats per day. L dogs (25+ kg): up to three treats per day. Select a chew slightly larger than your pet's mouth, always provide fresh water and supervise your dog while chewing.
